name: Nectar of the Dogs Wine
bio: Nectar of the Dogs Wine is a dog-friendly tasting room on Chambers Lane in Simi Valley, pouring its own California wines. It hosts a musicians' jam night on Thursdays and live music Friday and Saturday evenings, including Country Music Fridays.
source: public web search, the venue's website and public Instagram, and US Census address lookup, 2026-10-29
